message.content:
This editorial illustration for the cover of Tempo magazine features three human figures and several abstract shapes on a white background. On the right, a man in a brown suit and blue tie is depicted in a dynamic, stumbling pose, leaning to his right with one leg raised. He holds a large, curved, orange shape overhead with both hands. This shape has an irregular, porous texture and is angled diagonally. Behind him, a man in a black suit holds an identical large orange shape. Further to the left, a woman in a blue suit is shown in profile, appearing to move away while tossing several small, dark-blue, irregular shapes into the air. More of these blue shapes float above the central man in the black suit.

At the top, the large word "TEMPO" is printed in brown. Below it, the tagline reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline at the bottom-left states "KREDIT JUMBO UNTUK BAKRIE" in large, black, sans-serif font. Below this, smaller black text begins with "Sindikasi tiga bank nasional..." and ends with "...akhirnya diloloskan?" The right side includes a date "12-18 SEPTEMBER 2016," a price, a barcode, and other publication details.
